# 1. Setup
```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(data.table)
  library(xgboost)
  library(dplyr)
  library(mlr3)
  library(mlr3tuning)
  library(mlr3mbo)
  library(paradox)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(PRROC)
  library(mlr3learners)

})

set.seed(187)

SCRIPT_DIR   <- getwd()
PROJECT_ROOT <- normalizePath(file.path(SCRIPT_DIR, ".."), mustWork = FALSE)

OUTPUT_DIR <- file.path(PROJECT_ROOT, "output")
XGB_DIR    <- file.path(OUTPUT_DIR, "xgBoost_outputs")
TUNING_DIR <- file.path(XGB_DIR, "tuning")
PRED_DIR   <- file.path(XGB_DIR, "predictions")
MODEL_DIR  <- file.path(XGB_DIR, "models")

run_name <- "xgBoost_tuning_500evals_allParams"

data_file      <- file.path(XGB_DIR, "data_noSNP.tsv")
training_file  <- file.path(PROJECT_ROOT, "data", "eqtl_files", "training_data_snppg_aggregated_new.tsv.gz")
predictor_file <- file.path(XGB_DIR, "predictors.txt")

model_dir <- file.path(MODEL_DIR, run_name)
pred_dir  <- file.path(PRED_DIR,  run_name)
dir.create(model_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(pred_dir,  recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

feat_out <- file.path(model_dir, "feature_names.txt")
outfile  <- file.path(TUNING_DIR, run_name)
dir.create(outfile,  recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
```

```{r}
full_data <- fread(data_file)
training_data <- fread(training_file)
```

# 3.
```{r}
ct_map <- c(
  Ast = "astrocytes",
  MG  = "Microglia",
  OD  = "Oligodendrocytes",
  OPC = "OPC",
  IN  = "Neurons",     # fuse IN  → Neurons
  Ext = "Neurons",     # fuse Ext → Neurons
  End = "Endothelial"
)

remap_ct <- function(x) ifelse(x %in% names(ct_map), ct_map[x], x)

training_data[, celltype := remap_ct(celltype)]
full_data[,     celltype := remap_ct(celltype)]

full_data[, chr := tstrsplit(peak, "-", keep = 1L)]
training_data[, chr := tstrsplit(peak, "-", keep = 1L)]

# Merge on full identity
index_cols <- c("peak", "gene", "celltype", "chr")
setkeyv(full_data, index_cols)
setkeyv(training_data, index_cols)
data <- full_data[training_data, nomatch = 0L]

# Labels: 1 = pos, 2 = strong neg -> make 0/1
data[label == 2L, label := 0L]
data <- data[label %in% c(0L, 1L)]

cat(sprintf("Number of training instances: %s\n", nrow(data)))
cat(sprintf("Number of positives: %s\n", sum(data$label == 1L)))
cat(sprintf("Number of negatives: %s\n\n", sum(data$label == 0L)))

# Predictors
predictors <- scan(predictor_file, what = character(), quiet = TRUE)
feature_cols  <- intersect(predictors, names(data))

celltypes <- sort(unique(data$celltype))

```

```{r, eval=FALSE}
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)

# Recode labels first
donut_data <- data.frame(
  label = data$label,
  celltype = data$celltype
) %>%
  mutate(
    label = recode_factor(
      label,
      "0" = "Negative",
      "1" = "Positive",
      "3" = "Unclassified"
    )
  )

# Compute fractions, cumulative values, and label positions
donut_data <- donut_data %>%
  dplyr::count(label) %>%
  mutate(
    fraction = n / sum(n),
    ymax = cumsum(fraction),
    ymin = c(0, head(ymax, n = -1)),
    labelPosition = (ymax + ymin) / 2,
    labell = paste0(label, "\n(n = ", n, ")\n", round(fraction * 100, 1), "%")
  )

library(RColorBrewer)

labs <- levels(factor(donut_data$label))        # exact labels used in the plot
pal  <- RColorBrewer::brewer.pal(length(labs), "Dark2")  # current Dark2 colors

# swap green (#1B9E77) and orange (#D95F02), keep others (e.g., purple) unchanged
ig <- which(pal == "#D95F02")
io <- which(pal == "#1B9E77")
if (length(ig) == 1L && length(io) == 1L) pal[c(ig, io)] <- pal[c(io, ig)]

names(pal) <- labs

ggplot(donut_data, aes(ymax = ymax, ymin = ymin, xmax = 4, xmin = 3, fill = label)) +
  geom_rect(color = "white") +
  coord_polar(theta = "y") +
  xlim(c(2, 4)) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = pal) +
  theme_void(base_family = "montserrat_family") +
  theme(legend.position = "none", plot.title = element_blank())
```

# Functions
```{r}
tune_xgb <- function(X, y, chr, heldout_ct, outfile = ".") {
  df <- data.frame(X)
  df$label <- factor(y, levels = c(0, 1))
  df$chr   <- chr
  
  task <- TaskClassif$new(
    id       = paste0("xgb_tuning_", heldout_ct),
    backend  = df,
    target   = "label",
    positive = "1"
  )
  task$set_col_roles("chr", add_to = "group", remove_from = "feature")
  rs <- rsmp("cv", folds = length(unique(df$chr)))
  rs$instantiate(task)
  
  
  learner <- mlr3::lrn("classif.xgboost",
    booster     = "gbtree",
    objective   = "binary:logistic",
    nrounds     = 120,
    eval_metric = "aucpr",
    predict_type = "prob"
  )
  learner$param_set$values$nthread <- 16
  
  learner$param_set$values$gamma            <- generic_params$gamma
  learner$param_set$values$min_child_weight <- generic_params$min_child_weight
  learner$param_set$values$subsample        <- generic_params$subsample
  learner$param_set$values$colsample_bytree <- generic_params$colsample_bytree

  paramSet <- ParamSet$new(list(
    eta               = p_dbl(lower = 0.01,  upper = 0.3),
    max_depth         = p_int(lower = 3,     upper = 10),
    gamma             = p_dbl(lower = 0,     upper = 20),
    min_child_weight  = p_int(lower = 1,     upper = 20),
    subsample         = p_dbl(lower = 0.5,   upper = 1.0),
    colsample_bytree  = p_dbl(lower = 0.5,   upper = 1.0),
    lambda            = p_dbl(lower = 0,     upper = 1000),
    alpha             = p_dbl(lower = 0,     upper = 1000)
  ))
  
  measure <- msr("classif.logloss")

  terminator <- mlr3tuning::trm("combo",
                              list(mlr3tuning::trm("stagnation", iters=10, threshold=0.001),
                                   mlr3tuning::trm("evals", n_evals=500)), any=FALSE)
  rs <- rsmp("loo")
  rs$instantiate(task)
  

  inst <- mlr3tuning::ti(task=task,
                           learner=learner,
                           resampling=rs,
                           measure=measure,
                           search_space=paramSet,
                           terminator=terminator)
  tuner <- TunerMbo$new()
  tuner$optimize(inst)
  
  saveRDS(inst, file.path(outfile, paste0("tuning_instance_", heldout_ct, ".rds")))
  
  return(inst$result_learner_param_vals)
}

train_xgb <- function(X, y, params, folds, max_nrounds = 500) {
  # remove problematic keys from tuned params
  params$nrounds    <- NULL
  params$nthread    <- NULL
  params$objective  <- NULL
  params$eval_metric <- NULL
  
  # set the ones you actually want
  params$objective   <- "binary:logistic"
  params$eval_metric <- "aucpr"
  
  dtrain <- xgb.DMatrix(as.matrix(X), label = y)
  
  # CV to find best nrounds
  cv <- xgb.cv(
    data = dtrain,
    params = params,
    nrounds = max_nrounds,
    folds = folds,
    nthread = 8,
    early_stopping_rounds = 10,
    verbose = 1
  )
  
  best_nrounds <- cv$best_iteration
  
  # Final training
  bst <- xgb.train(
    params  = params,
    data    = dtrain,
    nrounds = best_nrounds,
    nthread = 8,
    verbose = 1
  )
  
  return(list(model = bst, best_nrounds = best_nrounds))
}

predict_and_score <- function(model_obj, X_test, y_test) {
  bst <- if (is.list(model_obj)) model_obj$model else model_obj
  p_hat <- predict(bst, as.matrix(X_test))
  
  logloss <- -mean(y_test*log(p_hat + 1e-15) + (1-y_test)*log(1 - p_hat + 1e-15))
  
  pr <- PRROC::pr.curve(scores.class0 = p_hat[y_test==1],
                        scores.class1 = p_hat[y_test==0],
                        curve = FALSE)
  
  return(list(
    preds = data.table(prob = p_hat, label = y_test),
    metrics = list(logloss = logloss, auprc = pr$auc.integral)
  ))
}



```

```{r}
results <- list()

for (ct in celltypes) {
  message("Held-out cell type: ", ct)
  
  # --- Split ---
  train_idx <- data$celltype != ct
  test_idx  <- data$celltype == ct
  
  X_train <- data[train_idx, ..feature_cols]
  y_train <- data$label[train_idx]
  chr_train <- data$chr[train_idx]
  
  X_test <- data[test_idx, ..feature_cols]
  y_test <- data$label[test_idx]
  
  # --- Tuning ---
  tuned_params <- tune_xgb(
    X_train, y_train, chr_train,
    heldout_ct = ct, outfile = outfile
  )
  
  # --- Training ---
  # chromosome folds
  chrs_train <- data$chr[train_idx]
  folds <- split(seq_along(chrs_train), chrs_train)
  
  message("training generic model")
  generic_model <- train_xgb(X_train, y_train, generic_params, folds = folds, max_nrounds = 500)
  
  message("training tuned model")
  tuned_model   <- train_xgb(X_train, y_train, tuned_params,   folds = folds, max_nrounds = 500)
  
  xgb.save(generic_model$model,
         fname = file.path(model_dir, paste0("xgb_generic_", ct, ".model")))

  xgb.save(tuned_model$model,
           fname = file.path(model_dir, paste0("xgb_tuned_", ct, ".model")))

  # --- Predict + score ---
  res_generic <- predict_and_score(generic_model, X_test, y_test)
  res_tuned   <- predict_and_score(tuned_model,   X_test, y_test)
  
  # --- Save predictions ---
  # Add metadata columns: heldout cell type, model type
  preds_generic <- cbind(
  data[test_idx, .(peak, gene, chr, celltype)],
  model = "generic model",
  res_generic$preds)

  preds_tuned <- cbind(data[test_idx, .(peak, gene, chr, celltype)], model = "tuned model", res_tuned$preds)
  
  data.table::fwrite(
    preds_generic,
    file = file.path(pred_dir, paste0("predictions_generic_", ct, ".tsv")),
    sep = "\t"
  )
  data.table::fwrite(
    preds_tuned,
    file = file.path(pred_dir, paste0("predictions_tuned_", ct, ".tsv")),
    sep = "\t"
  )
  
  # --- Collect summary metrics ---
  results[[ct]] <- list(
    tuned_params = tuned_params,
    generic = res_generic$metrics,
    tuned   = res_tuned$metrics
  )
}

# Save all summary metrics
saveRDS(results, file = file.path(pred_dir, "summary_metrics.rds"))
```

```{r fig.width=7.5, fig.height=6}
compute_pr <- function(df) {
  stopifnot(all(c("prob", "label") %in% names(df)))
  pr <- pr.curve(scores.class0 = df$prob[df$label == 1],
                 scores.class1 = df$prob[df$label == 0],
                 curve = TRUE)
  data.table(recall = pr$curve[,1],
             precision = pr$curve[,2],
             model = unique(df$model),
             aucpr = pr$auc.integral)
}

pr_curves <- rbindlist(lapply(split(all_preds, all_preds$model), compute_pr))


ggplot(pr_curves, aes(x = recall, y = precision, color = model)) +
  geom_smooth(se = FALSE, span = 0.3, linewidth = 1.2) +

    x = "Recall",
    y = "Precision",
    color = NULL,
    title = "PR Curves: Generic vs Tuned",
    subtitle = sprintf(

      unique(pr_curves[model == "generic model"]$aucpr),
      unique(pr_curves[model == "tuned model"]$aucpr)
```

```{r}
tuningInstances <- list.files(outfile, full.names = TRUE, pattern = "tuning_instance_.*\\.rds$")
archives <- lapply(tuningInstances, function(f) {
  inst <- readRDS(f)
  arch <- as.data.table(inst$archive$data)
  arch[, iter := seq_len(.N)]
  arch[, celltype := sub("tuning_instance_(.*)\\.rds", "\\1", basename(f))]
  
  # mark best row
  best_iter <- arch[which.min(classif.logloss), iter]
  arch[, best_iter := best_iter]
  return(arch)
})

all_arch <- rbindlist(archives)

# Plot
ggplot(all_arch, aes(x = iter, y = classif.logloss, color = celltype)) +
  geom_smooth(se = FALSE, size = 1.2, span = 0.3) +  # smooth curve per CT
  geom_vline(aes(xintercept = best_iter, color = celltype),
             data = unique(all_arch[, .(celltype, best_iter)]),
             linetype = "dashed", size = 0.8) +      # vertical line at min
  scale_y_log10() +
  labs(x = "Iteration", y = "Logloss (log scale)",
       title = "Tuning trajectories across cell types",
       subtitle = "Smoothed curves; dashed line = iteration of minimum logloss") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14)
```

```{r fig.width=7.5, fig.height = 6.5}
# --- read tuning results ---
tuningInstances <- list.files(outfile, full.names = TRUE, pattern = "tuning_instance_.*\\.rds$")
archives <- lapply(tuningInstances, function(f) {
  inst <- readRDS(f)

  return(arch)
})
all_archives <- rbindlist(archives)

# --- reshape ---
plot_dt <- melt(
  all_archives,
  id.vars = "celltype",
  #measure.vars = c("eta","max_depth","lambda","alpha", "min_child_weight","subsample","colsample_bytree","gamma"),
  measure.vars = c("eta","max_depth", "min_child_weight","subsample","colsample_bytree","gamma"),
  variable.name = "parameter",
  value.name = "value"
)

# --- define your generic (default) parameter values ---
generic_params <- list(
  eta = 0.05,
  max_depth = 6,
  lambda = 0,
  alpha = 0,
  min_child_weight = 6,
  subsample = 0.8,
  colsample_bytree = 1,
  gamma = 10
)

# --- build a small table of default values for easy joining ---
defaults_dt <- data.table(
  parameter = names(generic_params),
  default_value = as.numeric(generic_params)
)

# merge into plot_dt so each facet knows its reference line
plot_dt <- merge(plot_dt, defaults_dt, by = "parameter", all.x = TRUE)

celltype_cols <- c(
  "astrocytes"        = "#E87663",  # soft red
  "Microglia"         = "#9A9A00",  # olive
  "Neurons"           = "#2CA02C",  # green/teal

)
```

```{r fig.width=10, fig.height=8}
library(ggplot2)

# starting from your `all_archives` and `plot_dt` + `defaults_dt`:
plot_dt <- merge(plot_dt, defaults_dt, by="parameter", all.x=TRUE)

# order cell types within each parameter by |value - default|
plot_dt[, dev := value - default_value]
plot_dt[, ord := rank(-abs(dev), ties.method="first"), by = parameter]
plot_dt[, celltype_ord := factor(celltype, levels = unique(celltype[order(ord)])), by = parameter]

# color only by direction of change (up/down), not by parameter
plot_dt[, dir := fifelse(dev > 0, "↑ higher than default",
                  fifelse(dev < 0, "↓ lower than default", "＝ same"))]

ggplot(plot_dt,
       aes(x = value, y = celltype_ord)) +
  # segment from default to tuned
  geom_segment(aes(x = default_value, xend = value,
                   y = celltype_ord, yend = celltype_ord),
               linewidth = 0.8, color = "grey60") +
  # tuned point
  geom_point(aes(fill = dir), shape = 21, size = 2.6, color = "grey10") +
  # default line
  geom_vline(aes(xintercept = default_value),
             linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.6, color = "black") +
  facet_wrap(~ parameter, scales = "free_x") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("↑ higher than default"="#2E8B57",
                               "↓ lower than default"="#7B68EE",
                               "＝ same"="white")) +
  labs(x = "Parameter value", y = "Cell type",
       fill = NULL,
       title = "Best tuned XGBoost parameters per cell type",
       subtitle = "Dashed line = default; lollipop shows deviation from default") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom",
        panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
        axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 0, hjust = 0.5))
```

```{r fig.width=7.5, fig.height=6}
library(data.table)
library(PRROC)
library(ggplot2)

# --- Load predictions ---
pred_dir <- file.path(PRED_DIR, run_name)
pred_files <- list.files(pred_dir, pattern = "^predictions_tuned_.*\\.tsv$", full.names = TRUE)
all_preds <- rbindlist(lapply(pred_files, fread), fill = TRUE)

# --- Compute full PR curve per cell type (tuned only) ---
compute_pr_curve <- function(dt) {
  pos <- dt$prob[dt$label == 1]
  neg <- dt$prob[dt$label == 0]
  if (length(pos) == 0 || length(neg) == 0) return(NULL)
  pr <- PRROC::pr.curve(scores.class0 = pos, scores.class1 = neg, curve = TRUE)
  data.table(recall = pr$curve[,1],
             precision = pr$curve[,2],
             aucpr = pr$auc.integral)
}

pr_curves <- all_preds[, compute_pr_curve(.SD), by = celltype]

# --- Compute baseline precision ("lift") per cell type ---
baseline_dt <- all_preds[, .(
  baseline = mean(label)
), by = celltype]

# --- Define colors (your custom palette) ---
celltype_cols <- c(
  "astrocytes"        = "#E87663",  # soft red
  "Microglia"         = "#9A9A00",  # olive
  "Neurons"           = "#2CA02C",  # green/teal
  "Oligodendrocytes"  = "#4CC9F0",  # blue
  "OPC"               = "#D627A5"   # magenta
)

# --- Plot PR curves + baseline lift ---
ggplot(pr_curves, aes(x = recall, y = precision, color = celltype)) +
  geom_smooth(se = FALSE, span = 0.3, linewidth = 1) +
  # add one dashed baseline per celltype
  geom_hline(data = baseline_dt,
             aes(yintercept = baseline, color = celltype),
             linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.6, show.legend = FALSE) +
  labs(
    x = "Recall",
    y = "Precision",
    color = NULL,
    title = "Smoothed Precision–Recall Curves per Cell Type",
    subtitle = "Tuned model only — dashed line = baseline precision"
  ) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 15, base_family = "montserrat_family") +
  theme(
    panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    plot.title = element_text(family = "montserrat_family", face = "bold"),
    axis.title = element_text(family = "montserrat_family"),
    axis.text  = element_text(family = "montserrat_family"),
    legend.text = element_text(family = "montserrat_family"),
    legend.position = "bottom"
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(values = celltype_cols)

ggplot(lift_dt, aes(x = reorder(celltype, lift), y = lift, fill = celltype)) +
  geom_col(alpha = 0.9, width = 0.6) +
  geom_text(
    aes(label = sprintf("×%.1f", lift)),
    hjust = -0.2, size = 5, family = "montserrat_family"
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = celltype_cols) +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(
    x = "Cell type",
    y = "Lift (AUPRC / baseline)",
    title = "Model Lift per Cell Type",
    subtitle = "Ratio of AUPRC to baseline precision"
  ) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 17, base_family = "montserrat_family") +
  theme(
    panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", family = "montserrat_family"),
    axis.text.x = element_text(family = "montserrat_family"),
    axis.text.y = element_text(family = "montserrat_family"),
    legend.position = "none",
    plot.background = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA, size = 0.7)
  ) +
  ylim(0, max(lift_dt$lift) * 1.15)  # add headroom for labels

```
# Compare pgboost features & our features
```{r}
pred_files <- list.files(pred_dir, pattern = "^predictions_.*\\.tsv$", full.names = TRUE)
all_preds  <- rbindlist(lapply(pred_files, fread))
all_preds[, model := "tuned model"]

# --- Load pgBoost-features-only predictions ---
pgboost_path <- "/mnt/germain/work/tomohl/pgboost-project/output/xgBoost_outputs/predictions/xgBoost_loco_n1000_pgBoostFeatures/xgBoost_loco_n1000_pgBoostFeatures.tsv"
pgboost_preds <- fread(pgboost_path)

# Match column names and structure
pgboost_preds[, prob := xgBoost_probability]
pgboost_preds[, model := "pgBoost-only"]

# If you have labels available elsewhere, join them here
# Otherwise assume these are positive examples (or skip until labels are available)
# Let's check for presence of label column first
if (!"label" %in% names(pgboost_preds)) {
  message("No label column found — trying to infer or assign placeholder labels.")
  # Example: if you have external labels, merge them by peak/gene/celltype
  # Otherwise assign dummy 0/1 labels to avoid PRROC failure (placeholder)
  pgboost_preds[, label := NA_integer_]
}

# --- Combine and keep only matching columns ---
common_cols <- intersect(c("celltype", "prob", "label", "model"), names(pgboost_preds))
pgboost_preds <- pgboost_preds[, ..common_cols]
combined_preds <- rbindlist(list(all_preds[, ..common_cols], pgboost_preds), fill = TRUE)

# --- Check ---
print(head(combined_preds))

# --- Compute PR only for models that have labels ---
compute_pr <- function(df) {
  if (any(is.na(df$label))) return(NULL)
  pr <- pr.curve(
    scores.class0 = df$prob[df$label == 1],
    scores.class1 = df$prob[df$label == 0],
    curve = TRUE
  )
  data.table(
    recall = pr$curve[,1],
    precision = pr$curve[,2],
    model = unique(df$model),
    aucpr = pr$auc.integral
  )
}

pr_curves <- rbindlist(lapply(split(combined_preds, combined_preds$model), compute_pr), fill = TRUE)

# --- Plot ---
ggplot(pr_curves, aes(x = recall, y = precision, color = model)) +
  geom_smooth(se = FALSE, span = 0.3, linewidth = 1.2) +
  labs(
    x = "Recall",
    y = "Precision",
    color = NULL,
    title = "Precision–Recall Curves: Tuned vs. pgBoost-only Model",
    subtitle = sprintf(
      "AUPRC tuned = %.3f | pgBoost-only = %.3f",
      unique(pr_curves[model == 'tuned model']$aucpr),
      unique(pr_curves[model == 'pgBoost-only']$aucpr)
    )
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 15, base_family = "montserrat") +
  theme(
    legend.position = "bottom",
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(margin = margin(b = 10))
  )

```

```{r fig.width = 20, fig.height = 20}
library(data.table)
library(ggplot2)
library(patchwork)

data[, label := factor(label, levels = c(0, 1), labels = c("Negative", "Positive"))]
exclude_cols <- c("peak", "gene", "celltype", "chr", "gene_id", "label")
feature_cols <- setdiff(names(data), exclude_cols)
feature_cols <- feature_cols[sapply(data[, ..feature_cols], is.numeric)]

plots <- lapply(feature_cols, function(feat) {
  ggplot(data, aes(x = label, y = get(feat), fill = label)) +
    geom_violin(trim = TRUE, alpha = 0.6, color = NA) +
    geom_boxplot(width = 0.15, outlier.shape = NA, color = "black", alpha = 0.3) +
    labs(
      title = feat,
      x = NULL,
      y = "Feature value"
    ) +
    theme_classic(base_size = 12) +
    theme(
      legend.position = "none",
      plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 20, vjust = 0.8)
    )
})

wrap_plots(plots, ncol = 3)
```
